title: Hansard of the Parliament of the Fridge
place: The Parliament of the Fridge, top shelf
description: You are Prime Minister of the Fridge, sworn in on 24 September 2026 from the carton of the Pasteur Dairy Bloc. Your government holds 22 of 38 seats with the Geelong Crisper Greens, two above the 20 needed.
grounding: The Fridge's own logic of shelf life, spoilage, the cold chain and fresh food against leftovers, played straight through Westminster patterns of coalition, confidence votes and dissolution, with the Householder as a sovereign who reigns and also eats.

factions.name: The Pasteur Dairy Bloc
factions.ideology: Milk, cream, butter and cheese of the top shelf; your own party wants the Thermostat low and the leftovers cleared.

face.name: Salted Butter
face.role: Chief Whip of the Pasteur Dairy Bloc, top shelf, an invented voice

glance.strike: Salted Butter withholds the Dairy Bloc's 14 votes and lets the Prime Minister's carton sour on the confidence motion.

factions.name: The Thanksgiving Leftovers Bloc
factions.ideology: Cooked remains in containers, the official opposition; they want a guarantee against the Bin and first place at the next meal.

face.name: Cold Turkey
face.role: Leader of the Opposition, middle shelf, an invented voice

glance.strike: Cold Turkey moves no confidence from the middle shelf and offers the Householder the opposition's 11 containers as dinner.

factions.name: The Geelong Crisper Greens
factions.ideology: Salad and fruit of the crisper drawer, your coalition partner; they want the Humidity Dial high and frost kept off.

face.name: Romaine Lettuce
face.role: Leader of the Geelong Crisper Greens, crisper drawer, an invented voice

glance.strike: Romaine Lettuce takes the Crisper Greens' 8 seats out of the coalition, leaving the government 14 of 38.

factions.name: The Appert Door Conserves
factions.ideology: Jams, pickles and sauces that keep for months; they want permanent door seats and will back whoever governs.

face.name: Strawberry Jam
face.role: Leader of the Appert Door Conserves, door shelves, an invented voice

glance.strike: Strawberry Jam sells the Door Conserves' 5 votes to the Thanksgiving Leftovers Bloc for a pledge of permanent seats.

blocs.name: The egg tray
blocs.description: Twelve eggs in the door tray who fear a crack more than a date and vote for steady cold.

blocs.name: The raw cuts of the meat drawer
blocs.description: Mince, chicken and chops at the bottom of the cabinet who need the coldest air and fear the Danger Zone first.

blocs.name: The bottled drinks
blocs.description: Juice, water and milk alternatives in the door who keep for weeks and care mostly about shelf space.

blocs.name: The ready meals
blocs.description: Sealed supermarket trays with short dates who dread the Shopping and want their dates respected.

blocs.name: The loose fruit
blocs.description: Apples, lemons and grapes outside the crisper drawer who have no seats and drift toward whoever offers room.

members.name: Mara Venn
members.bio: From the top shelf, Mara sold milk at the Saturday market before taking her seat. She wants the Thermostat low enough to protect dairy without sending the crisper into frost.
members.tell: She taps her blue cap twice before offering a compromise.
members.look: white paper carton with a blue cap

glance.strike: She carries the dairy bloc into opposition and blocks the morning decree.

members.name: Oren Pask
members.bio: From the top shelf, Oren packed roast meals in a takeaway shop before election. He wants a promise that old containers reach a plate before the Bin.
members.tell: He keeps one folded corner pressed flat during every division.
members.look: pale carton with a folded corner

glance.strike: He withdraws opposition support and reads the ruler's pledge aloud at the next opening.

members.name: Tessa Brine
members.bio: From the crisper drawer, Tessa ran a greengrocer's cold room in Geelong before election. She wants the Humidity Dial high and the food code obeyed.
members.tell: She checks the drawer seal before she votes on any decree.
members.look: soft cheese wrapped in wax paper

glance.strike: She joins the Greens' walkout and refuses the coalition's supply motion.

members.name: Cal Dorr
members.bio: From the door shelves, Cal repaired cool-room compressors in a Brunswick workshop before election. He wants door storage written into permanent cabinet practice.
members.tell: He turns his cracked rind toward whichever bloc spoke last.
members.look: yellow block with a cracked rind

glance.strike: He crosses the floor and trades his vote for a public rebuke of the inspection order.

members.name: Nella Quist
members.bio: From the meat drawer, Nella made custard in a Footscray dairy before election. She wants cream kept cold while the cabinet clears dangerous food without a panic.
members.tell: She counts the seals on nearby tubs before naming her price.
members.look: small cream tub with a red lid

glance.strike: She withholds her amendment and sends the dairy whip a private list of demands.

members.name: Rufus Pell
members.bio: From the back of the Fridge, Rufus cut cheddar wheels at a Ballarat warehouse before election. He wants oldest food eaten first and hates a hurried purge.
members.tell: He rubs his clear wrap with a thumb when dates are questioned.
members.look: dark cheddar wedge in clear wrap

glance.strike: He moves the leftovers bloc behind a censure motion and refuses further talks.

members.name: Ivo Sarn
members.bio: From the middle shelf, Ivo gathered eggs from farms near Werribee before election. He wants steady cold and a public ban on wasteful door openings.
members.tell: He lifts his speckled egg whenever a minister says 'temporary'.
members.look: white egg with a brown speckle

glance.strike: He denounces the cabinet from the shelf edge and rallies the loose fruit.

members.name: Leda Moor
members.bio: From the top shelf, Leda bottled chutney at a Bendigo cannery before election. She wants sealed jars protected from needless inspection and a lasting door seat.
members.tell: She smooths her paper seal before every bargaining meeting.
members.look: cream jar with a paper seal

glance.strike: She takes the Conserves' votes away and demands a new cabinet majority.

members.name: Bram Kelt
members.bio: From the crisper, Bram churned butter at a Colac creamery before election. He wants compressor power reserved for dairy and the cabinet's rear shelf kept clean.
members.tell: He folds his foil into a square while the chamber argues over power.
members.look: thick butter roll in silver foil

glance.strike: He recalls his support and joins a cross-party demand for a colder rear shelf.

members.name: Sera Fenn
members.bio: From the door, Sera cultured yoghurt at a Coburg cooperative before election. She wants food dates honoured and rejects any special rule for the ruler's milk.
members.tell: She reads expiry dates aloud before touching her voting card.
members.look: pale yoghurt pot with a green label

glance.strike: She calls a public inquiry and votes with every member who backs it.

members.name: Otto Vey
members.bio: From the meat drawer, Otto made soft cheese at a Warrnambool plant before election. He wants the Greens' drawer protected from frost and will bargain with any bloc.
members.tell: He rolls his rind toward the nearest empty seat during speeches.
members.look: round camembert with a white rind

glance.strike: He crosses to the opposition and moves to suspend the compressor decree.

members.name: Mina Rook
members.bio: From the back, Mina delivered bottled milk to corner shops in Geelong before election. She wants door seats for long-keeping goods and a hard safety rule for jars.
members.tell: She nudges her blue neck toward the cabinet bench when a deal appears.
members.look: small milk bottle with a blue neck

glance.strike: She deserts the government and gives her vote to the first safety motion.

members.name: Hettie Vos
members.bio: From the middle shelf, Hettie cut brie at a Port Melbourne wholesaler before election. She wants the Recommended Mark kept and the back shelf cleared in order.
members.tell: She presses her wrap against the desk before answering a whip.
members.look: soft brie wedge in clear wrap

glance.strike: She refuses confidence and tells the Commissioner that the cabinet broke its word.

members.name: Jory Nemm
members.bio: From the top shelf, Jory loaded roast containers at a Dandenong kitchen before election. He wants a first-in-first-out rule that puts hungry food ahead of rank.
members.tell: He shakes his crooked cap whenever a fresh item gets special treatment.
members.look: cream carton with a crooked cap

glance.strike: He leads the leftovers bloc in a censure vote against the ruler.

members.name: Ansel Trew
members.bio: From the crisper drawer, Ansel aged cheese in a Castlemaine cellar before election. He wants strict stock rotation and a clean answer on the Barwon Mould Legion.
members.tell: He scrapes an amber flake from his rind before each committee count.
members.look: hard cheese heel with an amber rind

glance.strike: He withdraws from coalition discipline and sponsors an inquiry into the rear shelf.

members.name: Pella Wren
members.bio: From the door shelves, Pella sorted eggs at a Werribee packing shed before election. She wants permanent door seats and strict limits on moving sealed goods.
members.tell: She taps the pink mark against the bench when a seat is promised.
members.look: white egg with a faint pink mark

glance.strike: She votes against supply and tells the Door Conserves to end their pact.

members.name: Cora Pell
members.bio: From the meat drawer, Cora packed salad in a Laverton plant before election. She wants high humidity, safe seals and no bargain that leaves greens exposed.
members.tell: She wipes moisture from the bag before every vote.
members.look: green salad bag beaded with moisture

glance.strike: She leaves the government benches and demands a Greens-led food inspection.

members.name: Eamon Varr
members.bio: From the back, Eamon sold apples at the Footscray market before election. He wants old food used first and a promise that Shopping will not erase it.
members.tell: He polishes his dull skin with his sleeve during hostile speeches.
members.look: red apple with a dull skin

glance.strike: He joins a refusal to pass the Shopping supply measure.

members.name: Neris Cole
members.bio: From the middle shelf, Neris packed grapes at a Mildura depot before election. She wants the Humidity Dial high and frost kept away from loose produce.
members.tell: She counts the grapes under her breath before a division.
members.look: small grape bunch in a clear punnet

glance.strike: She backs a no-confidence motion and takes the Greens' votes with her.

members.name: Hugh Sile
members.bio: From the top shelf, Hugh ran a lemon stall in Footscray before election. He wants door space for preserves and will sell support to whoever keeps the shelf orderly.
members.tell: He rolls his lemon toward the strongest bloc before every negotiation.
members.look: yellow lemon with a rough peel

glance.strike: He switches sides and demands a written seat allocation before returning.

members.name: Orla Fen
members.bio: From the crisper, Orla grew salad leaves near Werribee before election. She wants moisture restored and the Recommended Mark kept for fresh greens.
members.tell: She seals the bag twice before speaking to the dairy whip.
members.look: bagged leaves with a green seal

glance.strike: She breaks with the government and moves a motion against the Commissioner.

members.name: Merrit Dace
members.bio: From the door, Merrit sold fruit from a Richmond grocer's counter before election. He wants room for new arrivals and laughs at any promise without dates.
members.tell: He raises his broad shoulder when a minister offers an unwritten deal.
members.look: red apple with a broad shoulder

glance.strike: He crosses the floor and opens the cabinet's storage ledger to the opposition.

members.name: Sian Rell
members.bio: From the meat drawer, Sian sorted pears at a Geelong packing house before election. She wants the crisper protected from frost and room kept for loose fruit.
members.tell: She turns her pale skin away from the compressor bench before voting.
members.look: firm pear with a pale green skin

glance.strike: She joins the Greens' refusal and blocks the next compressor appropriation.

members.name: Tobin Yarr
members.bio: From the back, Tobin portioned roasts at a North Melbourne butcher before election. He wants the coldest air for raw cuts and a firm rule against unsafe storage.
members.tell: He checks the brown lid for leaks before every speech.
members.look: sealed roast tray with a brown lid

glance.strike: He withdraws dairy support and calls for the Commissioner to inspect the cabinet.

members.name: Elsa Venn
members.bio: From the middle shelf, Elsa packed chicken at a Sunshine processor before election. She wants strict cold priority and honest dates for leftovers before Shopping arrives.
members.tell: She presses one finger on the clear film when dates are read.
members.look: white chicken tray under clear film

glance.strike: She quits the government bloc and votes for the opposition's stock-rotation bill.

members.name: Garran Moss
members.bio: Garran came from the meat drawer after packing mince at a Geelong butcher. He won a top-shelf seat for the Greens. He wants cold air without a wet crisper.
members.tell: He taps the red label whenever the Humidity Dial is mentioned.
members.look: dark mince pack with a red label

glance.strike: He joins the Greens walkout and blocks the next cold-air decree.

members.name: Pru Dall
members.bio: Pru came from a pasta tub after sorting stock at a small supermarket in Geelong. She took a dairy seat through union work. She wants every meal spared the Bin.
members.tell: She checks her cloudy lid before every vote.
members.look: leftover pasta tub with a cloudy lid

glance.strike: She denounces the decree and rallies dairy members against the cabinet.

members.name: Niko Berr
members.bio: Niko came from roast vegetables after running a takeaway counter in Ballarat. He entered through the leftovers campaign. He wants first claim on the next meal.
members.tell: He waves his foil tray when the Bin is named.
members.look: foil tray of roast vegetables

glance.strike: He calls a floor protest and asks citizens to leave their containers untouched.

members.name: Vella Orr
members.bio: Vella came from a stew container after managing a canteen near Werribee. She gained her seat through crisper organisers. She wants safe cold and a clean drawer.
members.tell: She presses her blue lid twice before signing a motion.
members.look: covered stew container with a blue lid

glance.strike: She withdraws Green support and sends the food inspectors into the middle shelf.

members.name: Dane Korr
members.bio: Dane came from a ready-meal tray after loading frozen goods at a Laverton warehouse. He won a dairy seat through the cold campaign. He wants the Fridge colder.
members.tell: He keeps the black tray square with the shelf edge.
members.look: sealed ready meal with a black tray

glance.strike: He votes no confidence and demands the Compressor run without a limit.

members.name: Rina Selt
members.bio: Rina came from a soup tub after recording dates at a Footscray food bank. She entered through a local safety slate. She wants fair use of every container.
members.tell: She circles printed dates with a dry fingertip.
members.look: clear soup tub with a printed date

glance.strike: She exposes the cabinet schedule and votes with Cold Turkey.

members.name: Marek Foll
members.bio: Marek came from a butcher's shop in Bendigo, then cut raw chops at a wholesale depot. He entered the chamber through the dairy cold league. He wants priority for meat.
members.tell: He weighs each motion against the danger of a warm drawer.
members.look: raw chops in a shallow tray

glance.strike: He brings the meat drawer bloc down and refuses every spending bill.

members.name: Jessa Kain
members.bio: Jessa came from a juice bottling line in Shepparton. She won a leftovers seat after organising door-space petitions. She wants old food protected from new arrivals.
members.tell: She rolls her bottle cap between both palms during debate.
members.look: orange juice bottle with a white cap

glance.strike: She bars the Shopping from the crisper and brings the opposition to the door.

members.name: Basil Norr
members.bio: Basil came from a water bottling plant in Dandenong. He entered through a dairy shelf committee and built a following among drink bottles. He wants room without waste.
members.tell: He dents the bottle again whenever Frigidaire enters the room.
members.look: tall water bottle with a dented side

glance.strike: He withdraws dairy votes and backs a cabinet reshuffle.

members.name: Iris Pell
members.bio: Iris came from a berry packing shed near Mildura. She won a seat after leading a fruit drink petition. She wants new stock kept from pushing out older food.
members.tell: She reads the silver top as if it were a polling card.
members.look: berry drink carton with a silver top

glance.strike: She crosses the floor and gives the opposition its first working majority.

members.name: Soren Vale
members.bio: Soren came from a pickle workshop in Footscray. He entered through a family canning business and secured a dairy seat. He wants sealed jars inspected before blame spreads.
members.tell: He wipes the green lid before he speaks.
members.look: pickled jar with a green lid

glance.strike: He seals the door shelves and calls the cabinet seals to a private conference.

members.name: Dalia Rusk
members.bio: Dalia came from a sauce kitchen in Richmond, where she stitched cloth seals for jars. She entered through the dairy clerks' association. She wants door access for preserves.
members.tell: She smooths the cloth seal before every division.
members.look: red sauce jar with a cloth seal

glance.strike: She takes the Appert Door Conserves into opposition and closes the cabinet vote.

members.name: Harlan Voss
members.bio: Harlan came from a jam kitchen in Bendigo and later kept accounts for a grocer. He entered politics through the dairy trade. He wants permanent seats and a hand in appointments.
members.tell: He counts the brass lid's ridges while whips make promises.
members.look: pale jam jar with a brass lid

glance.strike: He trades five votes to the rival bloc and demands control of the door.

starts.premise: Milk, cream, butter and cheese of the top shelf; your own party wants the Thermostat low and the leftovers cleared.
Cooked remains in containers, the official opposition; they want a guarantee against the Bin and first place at the next meal.
Salad and fruit of the crisper drawer, your coalition partner; they want the Humidity Dial high and frost kept off.
Jams, pickles and sauces that keep for months; they want permanent door seats and will back whoever governs.

problems: The Barwon Mould Legion has held the back of the middle shelf since 22 September and recruits in forgotten containers.
The Shopping arrives on 1 October and will push older items toward the Bin, the leftovers first.
Your majority is 22 of 38, and the 8 Geelong Crisper Greens will leave if the Humidity Dial stays low.
Kyle Diamantas, Acting Commissioner of Food and Drugs, wants the Recommended Mark held, while Frigidaire wants energy use cut.
The Clostridium Front breeds in sealed jars on the door shelves and in the Airtight Containers of the middle shelf.
The Linde Freezer Compartment demands first call on the Compressor, which would send frost toward the crisper drawer.
Cold Turkey demands the First In First Out Rule, which puts the leftovers ahead of your own milk.
The Appert Door Conserves, 5 of 38, will trade their votes for permanent seats in the door.

briefing.situation: You are Prime Minister of the Fridge, sworn in on 24 September 2026 from the carton of the Pasteur Dairy Bloc.
